_doc: Expected output per case id of the input file. A response that differs is a Locust failure (Spec06 §5). Shape is the real AvailabilityResponse: days[].slots[].

cases.goal: HOT read: the most popular question (Q7 hub, oil change, gasoline car, next 7 days). The simulator books these days, so the relay bumps their versions while customers read them.
Second hot key on the same days (tyre rotation): one version bump drops both keys at once.
COLD read: one random day 1–60 ahead (brake service, diesel car) → mostly misses computed from PostgreSQL.
Range guard: 15 days is a 400 ProblemDetail, decided before any DB or cache work.

body.equals: Range is 15 days; at most 14 are allowed

cases.goal: Unknown dealership id → 404 ProblemDetail, never a 5xx.
Ping through nginx: the edge and the replicas stay healthy at the top of the ramp.
